criteria.text: A turn delivered entirely via message.part.updated (zero message.part.delta events) finalizes normally: no error broadcast, transcript.append sent, session preview updated.
A turn with genuinely zero assistant text still produces the error branch (see #1455 for what that message should say).
No duplicate DB rows: the structured path must still skip the legacy messagesRepo.append.
Tests covering both: delta-only turn (existing behavior, unchanged) and part.updated-only turn (currently failing).
